Transfer Between Accounts

Transfers move money between your own accounts — the transfer amount itself doesn't count as income or expense and doesn't touch your jar budgets. Paying off a credit card is just a transfer into that card account. If your bank charges a fee for the transfer, add it below — the fee is real money spent, so it's counted under Total Expense as "Bank Charges" (jars stay untouched).

🏔️ Liability Settlement Plan

Compare the two best-known payoff strategies: Avalanche (highest interest rate first — saves the most money) and Snowball (smallest balance first — fastest psychological wins). Both roll each freed-up minimum payment into the next target debt.

6 Jars & Financial Freedom

How your income is split, spent, and growing toward financial freedom.

Target Allocation (The 6 Jars)

Every dollar of income you record is automatically split across these six jars, following T. Harv Eker's money-management system.

"It's not about how much money you make, it's about how much you keep, and how many generations you keep it for." — T. Harv Eker

Give Every Rupee a Job.

Every jar shows what's available, what's been spent this month, and whether you're on track against any limit you've set below.

📊 Budget Limits (This Month)

Set an optional monthly spending limit per Jar and/or per Category — leave blank for no limit. You'll get a warning toast when an expense pushes one past 80%, and another once it goes over.

By Jar

🌱 Financial Freedom — Your Number

Money in the FFA jar is never spent — only invested to build passive income. This is the one number that tells you how close you are to not needing a paycheck.

Financial Freedom Account
—

🎯 Savings Goals

Give your Long-Term Savings (LTSS) jar named targets — e.g. "New Laptop — Rs 150,000" — and track progress toward each one separately. Allocating funds here is just a way to mentally sub-divide your LTSS jar; it doesn't move any money on its own.

📖 User Guide

New to Finora, or not sure what a feature does? The guide covers every tab — accounts, the 6 Jars, transfers, budgets, recurring transactions, backups, and more.

Open the User Guide →

Home Currency

All totals — Net Worth, Cash Flow, the 6 Jars, charts — are shown in this currency. Individual accounts can still be opened in a different currency (see the Accounts tab); their balances get converted here using each account's own exchange rate.

🔔 Reminders

Nudge yourself to log expenses and stay on top of upcoming bill payments, right from your browser — no app install needed. Note: these use your browser's Notification permission, so they only arrive while this browser is running (not if it's fully closed) — a heads up rather than a guarantee.

✨ Finora Pro

🔓 See everything included with Finora Pro
  • Edit any past income, expense, or transfer entry (Free plan: view only)
  • Turn off the extra "are you sure?" step before deleting entries, if you don't want it
  • Advanced Reports — custom date ranges, compare any two periods, breakdown by account, filter by category, and CSV/Excel export
  • Shared Household — invite family members to view and edit the same synced data
  • No ads
  • More Pro features coming later

Pro-only: turn this off if the extra confirmation step feels unnecessary. Everyone else always gets asked.

🛠️ Admin — Grant Finora Pro

Give any Finora account Pro access without a real subscription — a fixed period, or permanently. Only visible to admin accounts; the server independently checks your email against ADMIN_EMAILS on every request, so this section being hidden or shown never affects security.
